function.name: create_primitive
function.description: Create a mesh primitive. kind is one of: plane, cube, circle, uv_sphere, ico_sphere, cylinder, cone, torus, grid, monkey, quad_sphere (all-quads sphere, good for sculpting). rotation is XYZ Euler in DEGREES. The new object is selected and active.

function.name: transform_object
function.description: Set absolute location/rotation/scale of an object. rotation is XYZ Euler in DEGREES. Omitted axes stay unchanged (each parameter replaces the whole transform component).

function.name: rename_object
function.description: Rename an object.

function.name: duplicate_object
function.description: Duplicate an object, optionally offsetting the copy by a vector.

offset.description: Offset added to the copy location

function.name: delete_objects
function.description: Delete objects by name.

function.name: join_objects
function.description: Join several mesh objects into the first one.

function.name: parent_objects
function.description: Parent child to parent. keep_transform keeps the child world pose.

function.name: create_collection
function.description: Create a collection linked to the scene.

function.name: assign_to_collection
function.description: Move objects into a collection (removes them from their current ones).

function.name: set_shading
function.description: Set smooth or flat shading on mesh objects.

function.name: batch_create
function.description: Create many primitives in a grid, circle or random (deterministic) arrangement. spacing is the distance between neighbours.

function.name: add_modifier
function.description: Add a modifier to an object. type is one of: subdivision, bevel, mirror, solidify, array, boolean, remesh, smooth, shrinkwrap, weld. Pass settings as extra keyword arguments matching Blender modifier attributes (e.g. subdivision: levels, render_levels, viewport; bevel: width, segments, angle_limit; mirror: use_axis_x/y/z, mirror_object; array: count, relative_offset_displace; boolean: object, operation; weld: merge_threshold).

function.name: set_modifier_params
function.description: Change parameters of an existing modifier.

function.name: remove_modifier
function.description: Remove a modifier from an object.

function.name: apply_modifier
function.description: Apply (bake) a modifier into the mesh. Object becomes active automatically.

function.name: list_modifiers
function.description: List an object's modifiers with their parameters (JSON).

function.name: create_material
function.description: Create a material with a Principled BSDF (reuses an existing material with the same name). base_color_rgba is [r,g,b,a] in 0..1.

function.name: set_material_params
function.description: Set Principled BSDF inputs on a material. Keys are socket names (Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Emission Strength, ...).

function.name: assign_material
function.description: Assign a material to an object (appends a new slot, or uses the given slot index).

function.name: list_materials
function.description: List material slot names of an object (JSON array).

function.name: uv_unwrap
function.description: Unwrap UVs of a mesh object. method: smart (default, Smart UV Project), angle (seam/angle based unwrap) or cube (cube projection). angle_limit in degrees, island_margin in world units.

function.name: sculpt_setup
function.description: Prepare a mesh object for sculpting: switches to Sculpt Mode and optionally enables dynamic topology (enable_dyntopo + detail_size), voxel-remeshes the mesh (voxel_remesh + voxel_size) or adds a Multires modifier (multires_levels).

function.name: get_scene_state
function.description: Inspect the current scene: objects (names, types, locations, vertex counts, modifiers, materials), selection, active object, mode and unit scale. Call this first when the request depends on scene context.

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Ask the user a clarifying question and wait for their answer. Use when a requirement is ambiguous instead of guessing. Provide 2-4 concrete options when possible; allow_free_text lets the user type a custom answer.

function.name: run_python
function.description: Run arbitrary bpy Python code for anything the structural tools cannot do. Keep the code short and readable; print useful results. Runs on the main thread ONLY after the user approves it in the panel.
